mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies near the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 49 degrees, feeling a bit cooler at 41.

In city news, Public Works has announced pavement repairs for November 10 and 11, affecting Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street. Also, the Plan Commission meets December 7 to review new development proposals for the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, or head over to the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow for more performances.

In our weekly look at police activity, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for a first offence O W I after he was found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for an extended period.
If you are hungry, Culver's is open now and will be serving until 10 PM tonight. Stop in to see what they have on the menu for their flavor of the day.
